_about: Interrupt lines shown when the app catches you in Shorts/Reels. 'wake' lines are the direct address (remember who you are). 'quotes' are from the people you named plus others. The app picks one wake + one quote and cycles without repeating until the pool is exhausted. Modern-speaker entries marked verbatim=false are paraphrases of ideas they are known for, not exact transcripts.
wake: Hey. Look up. Who are you, and what are you building?
This is not what you said you'd be doing today.
Remember who you are. This feed does not.
You have a purpose. This scroll is not it.
The person you want to become would not be here right now.
You opened this to escape something. Go face it instead.
Every swipe is a vote for who you're becoming. Vote differently.
Nobody is coming to pull you out. You pull you out.
What were you supposed to be doing? Go do that.
Your future self is watching this. Make them proud.
This is the moment. Not later. Put it down.
You are the one who said it mattered. Act like it.
The feed wins every time you don't decide. Decide.
You don't need another video. You need to go back to the work.
Thirty seconds ago you had a plan. Find it again.
Attention is the only thing you actually own. Stop giving it away.
Close it. Breathe. Go be who you are.

quotes.text: You have power over your mind, not outside events. Realize this, and you will find strength.
Waste no more time arguing about what a good man should be. Be one.
At dawn, when you have trouble getting out of bed, tell yourself: I have to go to work, as a human being. What do I have to complain of, if I'm going to do what I was born for?
Confine yourself to the present.
It is not death that a man should fear, but he should fear never beginning to live.
Think of yourself as dead. You have lived your life. Now take what's left and live it properly.
The journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step.
Knowing others is intelligence; knowing yourself is true wisdom. Mastering others is strength; mastering yourself is true power.
He who knows that enough is enough will always have enough.
Nature does not hurry, yet everything is accomplished.
If you do not change direction, you may end up where you are heading.
It is not that we have a short time to live, but that we waste a lot of it.
We suffer more often in imagination than in reality.
Begin at once to live, and count each separate day as a separate life.
First say to yourself what you would be; and then do what you have to do.
How long are you going to wait before you demand the best for yourself?
No man is free who is not master of himself.
He who has a why to live can bear almost any how.
If you spend too much time thinking about a thing, you'll never get it done.
Do not pray for an easy life, pray for the strength to endure a difficult one.
The man who moves a mountain begins by carrying away small stones.
Do nothing which is of no use.
The magic you are looking for is in the work you are avoiding.
You don't have a motivation problem. You have a clarity problem. Decide what you want and the rest is just reps.
The only way to fail is to stop. Everything else is just feedback.
Be so good they can't ignore you. That takes hours. This is not one of them.
The life you want is on the other side of a few hard conversations and a lot of boring work.
The algorithm is not your friend. It is a slot machine wearing a friend's face.
Nobody ever got to the end of a scrolling session and thought, that was a good use of my evening.
Your attention is being farmed. You are the crop.
The cost of a distracted life isn't the time. It's the person you don't become.
Every hour you give away is an hour you can't invest. Compounding only works on what you keep.
Discipline is choosing what you want most over what you want now.
Small, boring, consistent actions beat big, exciting, occasional ones. Every time.
Discipline equals freedom.
Don't expect to be motivated every day to get out there and make things happen. You won't be. Don't count on motivation. Count on discipline.
You are in danger of living a life so comfortable and soft that you will die without ever realizing your true potential.
Most people don't have the guts to do the work when no one is watching.
Every action you take is a vote for the type of person you wish to become.
You do not rise to the level of your goals. You fall to the level of your systems.
Clarity about what matters provides clarity about what does not.
The ability to concentrate without distraction is becoming increasingly rare at exactly the same time it is becoming increasingly valuable.
Escape competition through authenticity. Nobody can compete with you on being you.

The modern struggle: lone individuals summoning inhuman willpower, fasting, meditating, and exercising, up against armies of scientists and statisticians weaponizing abundant food, screens, and medicine into junk food, clickbait, and painkillers.
Compare yourself to who you were yesterday, not to who someone else is today.
If you're not building your dream, someone else is using you to build theirs. Right now it's an app.
The mind is everything. What you think you become.
Do not dwell in the past, do not dream of the future, concentrate the mind on the present moment.
Until you make the unconscious conscious, it will direct your life and you will call it fate.
Either you run the day or the day runs you.
Amusing ourselves to death.
The best time to plant a tree was 20 years ago. The second best time is now.
